workflow: Multiple threads first request a lazily computed descriptive value from the same shared object while its cache is empty.
Each thread computes the value and publishes it to the shared cache without synchronization.
Concurrent cache publication races, allowing one result to overwrite another and lose ownership of the replaced result.
The race produces undefined behavior and unreclaimed allocations instead of one safely shared cached value.
summary: Concurrent lazy-cache publication races and leaks replaced results
